Tested: "only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." A third-party global alone on a common subnet therefore still lacks the required matching link-local; this increment does not close that implementation gap or earn whole-requirement credit.
